title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-111-26二模

items.zh: 令人欣慰的是,越来越多的人有环保意识了。
items.en: To our relief, a growing number of people are developing environmental awareness.

items.zh: 无论去哪里旅游,我表姐都会尝试当地食物来体验文化。
items.en: My cousin will sample the local cuisine to experience the culture wherever she travels.

items.zh: 想起那个有商店和咖啡馆的老街区时,没有人不会油然而生一种向往之情。
items.en: When thinking of the old neighborhood with shops and cafes, no one can do so without a sense of yearning.

items.zh: 我们真的很幸运能有机会和像您这样大名鼎鼎的科学家面对面探讨我们感兴趣的话题。
items.en: We are truly fortunate to have the opportunity to sit down in person with a renowned scientist like you and discuss the topics of interest to us.
